svg.title: AVL tree LL rotation example
svg.desc: Shows inserting 30, 20, 10 into AVL tree causing left-left imbalance and right rotation to rebalance
svg.text: 4 AVL rotation cases (must memorize for exam)
LL case: right-heavy left child → single right rotation
RR case: left-heavy right child → single left rotation
LR case: left child right-heavy → left rotate child, then right rotate root
RL case: right child left-heavy → right rotate child, then left rotate root
